name: Topsort - Sponsored Banner
description: Renders the winning banner for one Topsort slot. Place it where the slot is configured to appear: the hero carousel slides for home-slider-5 and home-slider-6, or a full width row for home-banner-full. Nothing is rendered when no campaign wins the slot.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Topsort
attribute_definition_groups.description: Which configured banner slot this component fills.

attribute_definitions.name: Banner slot
attribute_definitions.description: Must match a slot configured both in cartridge/scripts/config/topsort_banners.json and in the Topsort dashboard. The creative size an advertiser can upload is set per slot, so this also decides how the banner is shaped.
